name: AirGateway NDC
auth_notes: API key in Authorization header (raw key, NOT Bearer prefix). Sandbox key from airgateway.com dashboard. Production key requires commercial agreement. No token expiry — key is permanent until rotated.
coverage_notes: 25+ airlines via NDC-direct (A3, AA, AF, AV, AY, BA, EK, IB, KL, LH, QF, SQ) plus AERTiCKET consolidator GDS content (Amadeus, Sabre, Travelport). POS arbitrage via metadata.country — same 102-country network as Redbox but per-request, not per-branch.
pricing_notes: Free search. Commission on bookings. Agency settles via AirGateway account (cash/card/ms). Look-to-book ratio ~1:2000.

quirks.issue: Auth header is raw key, NOT Bearer prefix

quirks.workaround: Client maps standard names to codes
Client tracks session age, returns session_expired if stale

quirks.issue: AG-Providers header controls which airlines respond
quirks.workaround: Use '*' for all, or comma-separated IATA codes

quirks.issue: Some airlines confirm async (OrderCreate returns pending)
quirks.workaround: Use OrderPoll every 5-10s, timeout after 2 min
If hold unsupported, booking proceeds as instant purchase

quirks.issue: AERTiCKET tickets on their IATA plate
quirks.workaround: No IATA required from customer for GDS content

booking_notes: Full NDC booking lifecycle. 11 NDC operations. Supports instant purchase and hold/reserve. Async confirmation via OrderPoll. Ticketing via AirDocIssue — NDC-direct airlines issue directly, AERTiCKET GDS content issues on their IATA plate. Date changes via OrderReshop workflow. Refund quotes with fare rules via OrderReshopRefund.
